subject.title: fix(polls): add default maximum poll option count

question: Should OpenClaw reject Matrix polls with more than 20 options before send, or truncate the event to the first 20 options as MSC3381 describes for clients?
rationale: Both choices can satisfy the protocol maximum, but they produce different user-visible upgrade behavior and the current repository contract does not establish which policy Matrix should expose.

options.title: Reject before send
options.body: Keep the clear validation error, share the limit constant, and require live Matrix proof that 20 options deliver while 21 fail before event emission.

options.title: Truncate to 20
options.body: Preserve successful sends for oversized inputs by explicitly truncating to 20 options and document or test the discarded-option behavior.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Leave current Matrix behavior unchanged until maintainers decide a uniform cross-channel oversized-poll policy.

recommendation.title: Reject before send
recommendation.body: Keep the clear validation error, share the limit constant, and require live Matrix proof that 20 options deliver while 21 fail before event emission.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most strongly connects this person to Matrix runtime behavior and the repository’s disposable Matrix QA infrastructure.
